thread:
maria: Heads-up — we need to standardize a small extension to GPU/service logs: add a pseudonymized session_id and a tenant_pseudonym for correlation. This is for evictions/capacity debugging and billing. Not full PII.
ben: +1. can we share a minimal schema proposal? want to avoid adding big arrays.
sam: pinging @olivia for privacy signoff but sounds fine if we hash tenant ids and only keep first 8 chars. :thumbsup:
olivia: agree with hashing+salted KMS rotate. also we should sample request payloads (1%) and keep full payloads only behind opt-in flags.
maria: rough schema idea below — keep it flat and optional: 
```json
{
  "timestamp": "iso8601",
  "service": "string",
  "host": "string",
  "gpu_id": "string",
  "metric": "string",
  "value": "number",
  "session_id": "hex8",
  "tenant_pseudonym": "hex8",
  "user_consent": "bool"
}
```
ben: looks good. suggest field names: `tenant_pseudonym` -> `tenant_pseud` (shorter) and `session_id` -> `sess` to keep sizes down. Also add `eviction_reason` optional.
sam: can we add a sampling header so the pipeline can drop bodies early? Example sampling config: 
```yaml
sampling:
  default_rate: 0.01 # 1%
  overrides:
    high_error: 1.0
    billing_events: 0.1
```
maria: yes. pipeline will check `X-Redwood-Sample: 1` and forward body to s3 bucket when set. otherwise body trimmed to `"<redacted>"`. 
olivia: for privacy: keep `tenant_pseudonym` irreversible; store salt in HSM. redact any free-text fields that match PII regex at ingest. maintain an allowlist for ops queries.
ben: on alerts side — our current GPU eviction alert fires too often because logs aren't correlated with session ids. propose updating Prometheus rule to group by `tenant_pseud`. Also tweak grafana panel to show per-tenant eviction rate. snippet: 
```yaml
- alert: GPUHighEvictionRate
  expr: sum by (tenant_pseud) (increase(gpu_evictions_total[15m])) / sum by (tenant_pseud) (increase(gpu_allocs_total[15m])) > 0.05
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: High GPU eviction rate for tenant {{ $labels.tenant_pseud }}
```
sam: nice. need to be careful about cardinality — `tenant_pseud` still could be many. we should cap dashboard series to top 25 and aggregate rest as `others`.
maria: agreed. for SLO dashboards: add a panel that ties 99th tail latency with eviction_rate and cost-per-token. This will help correlate regressions from rollouts.
olivia: ops + privacy checklist before rollout: 1) KMS key rotation policy 2) PII regex list 3) retention policy (30 days for detailed bodies) 4) allowlist for support.
maria: plan for rollout: canary in us-west-2 on one GPU pool next week, then ramp if no PII hits and alert noise down. @deploy-bot schedule canary?
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy to cluster gpu-pool-west-2 at 2026-05-05T03:00:00Z. (canary id: cny-20260505-01)
ben: I'll update the ingest lambda to apply the schema + sampling by EOD. sam — can you update grafana panels and alert rule repo?
sam: on it. will open PRs for dashboards + alerting, add query limits and topN aggregation.
maria: thanks all. small ask — when you open PRs, include sample log lines and a `grep`able list for oncall to use during the canary. :eyes:
olivia: making a short privacy note for the docs team.
maria: closing loop — we'll reconvene in #eng-sre if anything spikes during canary.
